mission: Get LifeMax's real backend (auth, persistence, onboarding, core game loop) running well enough to use daily for a week, privacy-first, before considering any external integration.

successMetrics.name: pnpm verify passes end to end
successMetrics.current: passes as of the D1 commit (lint, typecheck, unit, integration, architecture, build)

successMetrics.name: consecutive days of real personal use
successMetrics.target: 7 consecutive days, per the original v0 experiment plan

currentPriorities.title: Run the app locally and fix any remaining build/type issues
currentPriorities.rationale: The backend/core loop is built but has not been run end to end by the founder yet.

currentPriorities.title: Use it personally for 7 days and record friction
currentPriorities.rationale: The MVP question (would I voluntarily open this?) can only be answered by real use, not more building.

currentPriorities.title: Add a lightweight weekly review flow
currentPriorities.rationale: Named as the next structural gap after the core loop in the original roadmap.

risks.title: AI_MODE/telemetry could be enabled by accident, breaking the privacy commitment
risks.mitigation: Both default to disabled in .env.example; treat any change to these defaults as a decision, not a routine config edit.

risks.title: Product-market/personal fit is unproven — the core loop has never been used for real
risks.mitigation: Prioritized as p2 above: 7 days of real personal use before further building.
